The MediaPipe Gesture Recognizer task lets you recognize hand gestures in real time, and provides the recognized hand gesture results along with the landmarks of the detected hands. You can use this task to recognize specific hand gestures from a user, and invoke application features that correspond to those gestures. This task operates on image data with a machine learning (ML) model, and accepts either static data or a continuous stream. The task outputs hand landmarks in image coordinates, hand landmarks in world coordinates, handedness (left/right hand), and the hand gesture categories of multiple hands. [Open in Web Demos](https://google-ai-edge.github.io/mediapipe-samples-web/#/vision/gesture_recognizer)[Edit in StackBlitz](https://stackblitz.com/github/google-ai-edge/mediapipe-samples-web?file=src/tasks/gesture-recognizer.ts)
## Quickstart Install the SDK for your platform, [prepare input data](https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/prepare_data#vision), choose a running mode, and run inference. ### Web npm`npm install @mediapipe/tasks-vision`[Web demo](https://google-ai-edge.github.io/mediapipe-samples-web/#/vision/gesture_recognizer)·[Edit in StackBlitz](https://stackblitz.com/github/google-ai-edge/mediapipe-samples-web?file=src/tasks/gesture-recognizer.ts)·[Setup guide](https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/setup_web) #### Image `IMAGE`Stateless · single frameSynchronous call on independent still images. Resets temporal tracking state on every call. ```typescript import { FilesetResolver, GestureRecognizer } from "@mediapipe/tasks-vision"; const vision = await FilesetResolver.forVisionTasks( "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@mediapipe/tasks-vision@latest/wasm" ); const gestureRecognizer = await GestureRecognizer.createFromOptions(vision, { baseOptions: { modelAssetPath: "gesture_recognizer.task", delegate: "GPU" }, runningMode: "IMAGE", numHands: 2, }); // Synchronous single-frame call (stateless across images) const image = document.getElementById("image") as HTMLImageElement; const result = gestureRecognizer.recognize(image); ``` #### Video `VIDEO`Every frame · no dropsSynchronous tracking across decoded video frames with monotonic timestamps. Processes every frame in order and never drops frames. ```typescript import { FilesetResolver, GestureRecognizer } from "@mediapipe/tasks-vision"; const vision = await FilesetResolver.forVisionTasks( "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@mediapipe/tasks-vision@latest/wasm" ); const gestureRecognizer = await GestureRecognizer.createFromOptions(vision, { baseOptions: { modelAssetPath: "gesture_recognizer.task", delegate: "GPU" }, runningMode: "VIDEO", numHands: 2, }); // Synchronous across decoded frames with monotonic timestamps (never drops frames) for (const { frame, timestampMs } of decodedVideoFrames) { const result = gestureRecognizer.recognizeForVideo(frame, timestampMs); } ``` #### Livestream `VIDEO + rAF`Live camera · latest frameWeb tasks run synchronously---pair `runningMode: "VIDEO"` with `requestAnimationFrame` so each paint inspects only the latest camera frame (skipping intermediate frames when busy). ```typescript import { FilesetResolver, GestureRecognizer } from "@mediapipe/tasks-vision"; const vision = await FilesetResolver.forVisionTasks( "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@mediapipe/tasks-vision@latest/wasm" ); // On Web, live camera loops pair runningMode: "VIDEO" with requestAnimationFrame const gestureRecognizer = await GestureRecognizer.createFromOptions(vision, { baseOptions: { modelAssetPath: "gesture_recognizer.task", delegate: "GPU" }, runningMode: "VIDEO", numHands: 2, }); const video = document.getElementById("webcam") as HTMLVideoElement; video.srcObject = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ video: true }); await video.play(); let lastVideoTime = -1; function renderLoop() { if (video.readyState >= 2 && video.currentTime !== lastVideoTime) { lastVideoTime = video.currentTime; const result = gestureRecognizer.recognizeForVideo(video, performance.now()); console.log(result.gestures, result.landmarks); } requestAnimationFrame(renderLoop); } renderLoop(); ``` ### Android (Kotlin) Gradle`implementation("com.google.mediapipe:tasks-vision:latest.release")`[Sample code](https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe-samples/tree/main/examples/gesture_recognizer/android)·[Setup guide](https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/setup_android) #### Image `IMAGE`Stateless · single frameSynchronous call on independent still images. Resets temporal tracking state on every call. ```kotlin import com.google.mediapipe.framework.image.BitmapImageBuilder import com.google.mediapipe.framework.image.MPImage import com.google.mediapipe.tasks.core.BaseOptions import com.google.mediapipe.tasks.vision.core.RunningMode import com.google.mediapipe.tasks.vision.gesturerecognizer.GestureRecognizer val baseOptions = BaseOptions.builder() .setModelAssetPath("gesture_recognizer.task") .build() val options = GestureRecognizer.GestureRecognizerOptions.builder() .setBaseOptions(baseOptions) .setRunningMode(RunningMode.IMAGE) .setNumHands(2) .build() val gestureRecognizer = GestureRecognizer.createFromOptions(context, options) // Synchronous single-image call (no temporal tracking across calls) val mpImage = BitmapImageBuilder(bitmap).build() val result = gestureRecognizer.recognize(mpImage) ``` #### Video `VIDEO`Every frame · no dropsSynchronous tracking across decoded video frames with monotonic timestamps. Processes every frame in order and never drops frames. ```kotlin import com.google.mediapipe.framework.image.BitmapImageBuilder import com.google.mediapipe.framework.image.MPImage import com.google.mediapipe.tasks.core.BaseOptions import com.google.mediapipe.tasks.vision.core.RunningMode import com.google.mediapipe.tasks.vision.gesturerecognizer.GestureRecognizer val baseOptions = BaseOptions.builder() .setModelAssetPath("gesture_recognizer.task") .build() val options = GestureRecognizer.GestureRecognizerOptions.builder() .setBaseOptions(baseOptions) .setRunningMode(RunningMode.VIDEO) .setNumHands(2) .build() val gestureRecognizer = GestureRecognizer.createFromOptions(context, options) // Synchronous: processes every frame in order with monotonic timestamps (no frame drops) val mpImage = BitmapImageBuilder(frameBitmap).build() val result = gestureRecognizer.recognizeForVideo(mpImage, frameTimestampMs) ``` #### Livestream `LIVE_STREAM`Async · drops frames when busyAsynchronous camera pipeline with a result callback. Automatically drops incoming frames when busy so results stay current with low latency. ```kotlin import android.os.SystemClock import android.util.Log import com.google.mediapipe.framework.image.BitmapImageBuilder import com.google.mediapipe.framework.image.MPImage import com.google.mediapipe.tasks.core.BaseOptions import com.google.mediapipe.tasks.vision.core.RunningMode import com.google.mediapipe.tasks.vision.gesturerecognizer.GestureRecognizer val baseOptions = BaseOptions.builder() .setModelAssetPath("gesture_recognizer.task") .build() val options = GestureRecognizer.GestureRecognizerOptions.builder() .setBaseOptions(baseOptions) .setRunningMode(RunningMode.LIVE_STREAM) .setNumHands(2) .setResultListener { result, _ -> val topGesture = result.gestures().firstOrNull()?.firstOrNull() } .setErrorListener { error -> Log.e("MediaPipe", error.message.orEmpty()) } .build() val gestureRecognizer = GestureRecognizer.createFromOptions(context, options) // Async: automatically drops incoming camera frames when busy so results stay current gestureRecognizer.recognizeAsync(mpImage, SystemClock.uptimeMillis()) ``` ### Android (Java) Gradle`implementation 'com.google.mediapipe:tasks-vision:latest.release'`[Sample code](https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe-samples/tree/main/examples/gesture_recognizer/android)·[Setup guide](https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/setup_android) #### Image `IMAGE`Stateless · single frameSynchronous call on independent still images. Resets temporal tracking state on every call. ```java import com.google.mediapipe.framework.image.BitmapImageBuilder; import com.google.mediapipe.framework.image.MPImage; import com.google.mediapipe.tasks.core.BaseOptions; import com.google.mediapipe.tasks.vision.core.RunningMode; import com.google.mediapipe.tasks.vision.gesturerecognizer.GestureRecognizer; import com.google.mediapipe.tasks.vision.gesturerecognizer.GestureRecognizerResult; BaseOptions baseOptions = BaseOptions.builder() .setModelAssetPath("gesture_recognizer.task") .build(); GestureRecognizer.GestureRecognizerOptions options = GestureRecognizer.GestureRecognizerOptions.builder() .setBaseOptions(baseOptions) .setRunningMode(RunningMode.IMAGE) .setNumHands(2) .build(); GestureRecognizer gestureRecognizer = GestureRecognizer.createFromOptions(context, options); // Synchronous single-image call (no temporal tracking across calls) MPImage mpImage = new BitmapImageBuilder(bitmap).build(); GestureRecognizerResult result = gestureRecognizer.recognize(mpImage); ``` #### Video `VIDEO`Every frame · no dropsSynchronous tracking across decoded video frames with monotonic timestamps. Processes every frame in order and never drops frames. ```java import com.google.mediapipe.framework.image.BitmapImageBuilder; import com.google.mediapipe.framework.image.MPImage; import com.google.mediapipe.tasks.core.BaseOptions; import com.google.mediapipe.tasks.vision.core.RunningMode; import com.google.mediapipe.tasks.vision.gesturerecognizer.GestureRecognizer; import com.google.mediapipe.tasks.vision.gesturerecognizer.GestureRecognizerResult; BaseOptions baseOptions = BaseOptions.builder() .setModelAssetPath("gesture_recognizer.task") .build(); GestureRecognizer.GestureRecognizerOptions options = GestureRecognizer.GestureRecognizerOptions.builder() .setBaseOptions(baseOptions) .setRunningMode(RunningMode.VIDEO) .setNumHands(2) .build(); GestureRecognizer gestureRecognizer = GestureRecognizer.createFromOptions(context, options); // Synchronous: processes every frame in order with monotonic timestamps (no frame drops) MPImage mpImage = new BitmapImageBuilder(frameBitmap).build(); GestureRecognizerResult result = gestureRecognizer.recognizeForVideo(mpImage, frameTimestampMs); ``` #### Livestream `LIVE_STREAM`Async · drops frames when busyAsynchronous camera pipeline with a result callback. Automatically drops incoming frames when busy so results stay current with low latency. ```java import android.os.SystemClock; import android.util.Log; import com.google.mediapipe.framework.image.BitmapImageBuilder; import com.google.mediapipe.framework.image.MPImage; import com.google.mediapipe.tasks.core.BaseOptions; import com.google.mediapipe.tasks.vision.core.RunningMode; import com.google.mediapipe.tasks.vision.gesturerecognizer.GestureRecognizer; BaseOptions baseOptions = BaseOptions.builder() .setModelAssetPath("gesture_recognizer.task") .build(); GestureRecognizer.GestureRecognizerOptions options = GestureRecognizer.GestureRecognizerOptions.builder() .setBaseOptions(baseOptions) .setRunningMode(RunningMode.LIVE_STREAM) .setNumHands(2) .setResultListener((result, inputImage) -> { var gestures = result.gestures(); }) .setErrorListener(error -> Log.e("MediaPipe", String.valueOf(error.getMessage()))) .build(); GestureRecognizer gestureRecognizer = GestureRecognizer.createFromOptions(context, options); // Async: automatically drops incoming camera frames when busy so results stay current gestureRecognizer.recognizeAsync(mpImage, SystemClock.uptimeMillis()); ``` ### iOS SwiftPM`https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe → MediaPipeTasksVision`[Package.swift](https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/setup_ios#package_swift)·[Sample code](https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe-samples/tree/main/examples/gesture_recognizer/ios)·[Setup guide](https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/setup_ios) #### Image `IMAGE`Stateless · single frameSynchronous call on independent still images. Resets temporal tracking state on every call. ```swift import Foundation import MediaPipeTasksVision guard let modelPath = Bundle.main.path(forResource: "gesture_recognizer", ofType: "task") else { return } let options = GestureRecognizerOptions() options.baseOptions.modelAssetPath = modelPath options.runningMode = .image options.numHands = 2 let gestureRecognizer = try GestureRecognizer(options: options) // Synchronous single-image call (stateless across images) let mpImage = try MPImage(uiImage: image) let result = try gestureRecognizer.recognize(image: mpImage) ``` #### Video `VIDEO`Every frame · no dropsSynchronous tracking across decoded video frames with monotonic timestamps. Processes every frame in order and never drops frames. ```swift import Foundation import MediaPipeTasksVision guard let modelPath = Bundle.main.path(forResource: "gesture_recognizer", ofType: "task") else { return } let options = GestureRecognizerOptions() options.baseOptions.modelAssetPath = modelPath options.runningMode = .video options.numHands = 2 let gestureRecognizer = try GestureRecognizer(options: options) // Synchronous: processes every frame in order with monotonic timestamps (no frame drops) let mpImage = try MPImage(pixelBuffer: pixelBuffer) let result = try gestureRecognizer.recognize(videoFrame: mpImage, timestampInMilliseconds: timestampMs) ``` #### Livestream `LIVE_STREAM`Async · drops frames when busyAsynchronous camera pipeline with a result callback. Automatically drops incoming frames when busy so results stay current with low latency. ```swift import Foundation import MediaPipeTasksVision final class GestureRecognizerStreamService: NSObject { private var gestureRecognizer: GestureRecognizer? func setUp() throws { guard let modelPath = Bundle.main.path( forResource: "gesture_recognizer", ofType: "task" ) else { return } let options = GestureRecognizerOptions() options.baseOptions.modelAssetPath = modelPath options.runningMode = .liveStream options.numHands = 2 options.gestureRecognizerLiveStreamDelegate = self gestureRecognizer = try GestureRecognizer(options: options) } func recognizeAsync(mpImage: MPImage, timestampMs: Int) throws { // Async: automatically drops incoming camera frames when busy so results stay current try gestureRecognizer?.recognizeAsync(image: mpImage, timestampInMilliseconds: timestampMs) } } extension GestureRecognizerStreamService: GestureRecognizerLiveStreamDelegate { func gestureRecognizer( _ gestureRecognizer: GestureRecognizer, didFinishGestureRecognition result: GestureRecognizerResult?, timestampInMilliseconds: Int, error: (any Error)? ) { guard let result else { return } DispatchQueue.main.async { let topGesture = result.gestures.first?.first } } } ``` ### Python pip`pip install mediapipe`[Sample code](https://colab.research.google.com/github/google-ai-edge/mediapipe-samples/blob/main/examples/gesture_recognizer/python/gesture_recognizer.ipynb)·[Setup guide](https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/setup_python) #### Image `IMAGE`Stateless · single frameSynchronous call on independent still images. Resets temporal tracking state on every call. ```python import mediapipe as mp BaseOptions = mp.tasks.BaseOptions GestureRecognizer = mp.tasks.vision.GestureRecognizer GestureRecognizerOptions = mp.tasks.vision.GestureRecognizerOptions VisionRunningMode = mp.tasks.vision.RunningMode options = GestureRecognizerOptions( base_options=BaseOptions(model_asset_path="gesture_recognizer.task"), running_mode=VisionRunningMode.IMAGE, num_hands=2, ) with GestureRecognizer.create_from_options(options) as recognizer: # Synchronous single-image call (stateless across images) mp_image = mp.Image.create_from_file("input.jpg") result = recognizer.recognize(mp_image) ``` #### Video `VIDEO`Every frame · no dropsSynchronous tracking across decoded video frames with monotonic timestamps. Processes every frame in order and never drops frames. ```python import mediapipe as mp BaseOptions = mp.tasks.BaseOptions GestureRecognizer = mp.tasks.vision.GestureRecognizer GestureRecognizerOptions = mp.tasks.vision.GestureRecognizerOptions VisionRunningMode = mp.tasks.vision.RunningMode options = GestureRecognizerOptions( base_options=BaseOptions(model_asset_path="gesture_recognizer.task"), running_mode=VisionRunningMode.VIDEO, num_hands=2, ) with GestureRecognizer.create_from_options(options) as recognizer: # Synchronous: processes every frame in order with monotonic timestamps (no frame drops) for mp_image, timestamp_ms in decoded_video_frames: result = recognizer.recognize_for_video(mp_image, timestamp_ms) ``` #### Livestream `LIVE_STREAM`Async · drops frames when busyAsynchronous camera pipeline with a result callback. Automatically drops incoming frames when busy so results stay current with low latency. ```python import mediapipe as mp BaseOptions = mp.tasks.BaseOptions GestureRecognizer = mp.tasks.vision.GestureRecognizer GestureRecognizerOptions = mp.tasks.vision.GestureRecognizerOptions VisionRunningMode = mp.tasks.vision.RunningMode def on_result(result, output_image: mp.Image, timestamp_ms: int): print(f"Gestures at {timestamp_ms} ms: {result.gestures}") options = GestureRecognizerOptions( base_options=BaseOptions(model_asset_path="gesture_recognizer.task"), running_mode=VisionRunningMode.LIVE_STREAM, num_hands=2, result_callback=on_result, ) with GestureRecognizer.create_from_options(options) as recognizer: # Async: automatically drops incoming camera frames when busy so results stay current mp_image = mp.Image(image_format=mp.ImageFormat.SRGB, data=rgb_frame) recognizer.recognize_async(mp_image, timestamp_ms) ``` ## Task details This section describes the capabilities, inputs, outputs, and configuration options of this task. ### Features - **Input image processing** - Processing includes image rotation, resizing, normalization, and color space conversion. - **Score threshold** - Filter results based on prediction scores. - **Label allowlist and denylist** - Specify the gesture categories recognized by the model. Inputs The Gesture Recognizer accepts an input of one of the following data types: - Still images - Decoded video frames - Live video feed See [Prepare vision input data](https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/prepare_data#vision) for `MPImage`, `mp.Image`, and browser media examples. Outputs The Gesture Recognizer outputs the following results: - Categories of hand gestures - Handedness of detected hands - Landmarks of detected hands in image coordinates - Landmarks of detected hands in world coordinates > [!NOTE] > **Note:** Left and Right handedness correspond to the subject's hands, not the viewer. Passing a horizontally mirrored image will invert these outputs. ### Configuration options This task has the following configuration options: ### Web | Option Name | Description | Value Range | Default Value | |---|---|---|---| | `runningMode` | Sets the running mode for the task: `IMAGE`: Single image inputs. `VIDEO`: Decoded video frames and live camera streams. | {`IMAGE`, `VIDEO`} | `IMAGE` | | `numHands` | The maximum number of hands detected by the `GestureRecognizer`. | Integer \> 0 | `1` | | `minHandDetectionConfidence` | The minimum confidence score for palm detection to be considered successful. | Float `[0.0, 1.0]` | `0.5` | | `minHandPresenceConfidence` | The minimum confidence score for hand presence in the hand landmark model. In `VIDEO` and `LIVE_STREAM` modes, a score lower than this threshold re-triggers palm detection. | Float `[0.0, 1.0]` | `0.5` | | `minTrackingConfidence` | The minimum bounding-box IoU threshold between consecutive frames for hand tracking to be considered successful in `VIDEO` and `LIVE_STREAM` modes. | Float `[0.0, 1.0]` | `0.5` | | `cannedGesturesClassifierOptions` | Classifier options for built-in gestures (`["None", "Closed_Fist", "Open_Palm", "Pointing_Up", "Thumb_Down", "Thumb_Up", "Victory", "ILoveYou"]`; Recognizer uses a model bundle that contains two packaged model bundles: a hand landmark model bundle and a gesture classification model bundle. The landmark model detects the presence of hands and hand geometry, and the gesture recognition model recognizes gestures based on hand geometry. | Model name | Input shape | Quantization type | Model Card | Versions | |---|---|---|---|---| | [HandGestureClassifier](https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/gesture_recognizer/gesture_recognizer/float16/latest/gesture_recognizer.task) | 192 x 192, 224 x 224 | float 16 | [info](https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-assets/gesture_recognizer/model_card_hand_gesture_classification_with_faireness_2022.pdf) | [Latest](https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/gesture_recognizer/gesture_recognizer/float16/latest/gesture_recognizer.task) | ### Hand landmark model bundle The hand landmark model bundle detects the keypoint localization of 21 hand-knuckle coordinates within the detected hand regions. The model was trained on approximately 30K real-world images, as well as several rendered synthetic hand models imposed over various backgrounds. See the following definition of the 21 landmarks: ![21 3D hand landmarks index map](https://developers.google.com/static/edge/mediapipe/images/solutions/diagrams/hand_landmarks.svg) | ID | Landmark | ID | Landmark | |---|---|---|---| | `0` | `WRIST` | `11` | `MIDDLE_FINGER_DIP` | | `1` | `THUMB_CMC` | `12` | `MIDDLE_FINGER_TIP` | | `2` | `THUMB_MCP` | `13` | `RING_FINGER_MCP` | | `3` | `THUMB_IP` | `14` | `RING_FINGER_PIP` | | `4` | `THUMB_TIP` | `15` | `RING_FINGER_DIP` | | `5` | `INDEX_FINGER_MCP` | `16` | `RING_FINGER_TIP` | | `6` | `INDEX_FINGER_PIP` | `17` | `PINKY_MCP` | | `7` | `INDEX_FINGER_DIP` | `18` | `PINKY_PIP` | | `8` | `INDEX_FINGER_TIP` | `19` | `PINKY_DIP` | | `9` | `MIDDLE_FINGER_MCP` | `20` | `PINKY_TIP` | | `10` | `MIDDLE_FINGER_PIP` | | | The hand landmarker model bundle contains a palm detection model and a hand landmarks detection model. The palm detection model locates hands within the input image, and the hand landmarks detection model identifies specific hand landmarks on the cropped hand image defined by the palm detection model. Because running the palm detection model is time consuming, in `VIDEO` and `LIVE_STREAM` running modes the Gesture Recognizer uses the bounding box defined by the hand landmarks detected in the current frame to localize the hands in the next frame. This reduces how often the Gesture Recognizer runs the palm detection model. The palm detection model runs again only when the hand landmarks model no longer identifies the required number of hands, or when hand tracking fails. > [!NOTE] > **Note:** If your app only requires hand landmark detection, use the [Hand Landmarker](https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/hand_landmarker) task. ### Gesture classification model bundle The Gesture classification model bundle can recognize these common hand gestures: ![Built-in recognized hand gestures](https://developers.google.com/static/edge/mediapipe/images/solutions/diagrams/gestures_grid.svg) | ID | Category Label | Gesture | |---|---|---| | `0` | `Unknown` / `None` | Unrecognized hand pose | | `1` | `Closed_Fist` | Closed fist | | `2` | `Open_Palm` | Open palm | | `3` | `Pointing_Up` | Index finger pointing up | | `4` | `Thumb_Down` | Thumb pointing down | | `5` | `Thumb_Up` | Thumb pointing up | | `6` | `Victory` | Peace / victory sign | | `7` | `ILoveYou` | ASL "I Love You" sign | If the model detects hands but does not recognize a gesture, the gesture recognizer returns a result of "None". If the model does not detect hands, the gesture recognizer returns empty. The gesture classification model bundle contains two step neural network pipeline with a gesture embedding model followed by a gesture classification model. See more details in [Gesture classification model card](https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-assets/gesture_recognizer/model_card_hand_gesture_classification_with_faireness_2022.pdf). The gesture embedding model encodes the image features into a feature vector, and the classification model is a lightweight gesture classifier taking the feature vector as input. The provided gesture classification model bundle contains the canned gestures classifier, which detects the 7 common hand gestures listed earlier. You can extend the model bundle to recognize more gestures by bundling your own custom gesture classifier. Gesture Recognizer with both canned gesture classifier and custom gesture classifier prefers the custom gesture if both classifiers recognize the same gesture in their categories. If only one gesture classifier recognizes the gesture, Gesture Recognizer outputs the recognized gesture directly. ## Task benchmarks Here are the task benchmarks for the whole pipeline based on the preceding pre-trained models.
